quote.text: Your happiness depends on three things, all of which are within your power: your will, your ideas concerning the events in which you are involved, and the use you make of your ideas.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that your will is the compass in the journey of raising children; by nurturing your inner strength, you demonstrate resilience and fortitude in the face of everyday challenges.
    • Understand that the ideas you hold about parenting—each setback, success, or misstep—are opportunities to reshape your approach, turning difficult moments into lessons of care and growth.
  • Leadership
    • In leadership, the power to shape outcomes begins with a firm will; your personal determination and clear purpose ripple outward, inspiring and guiding your team.
    • Reframe the events around you by interpreting challenges as invitations to learn and adapt, thereby transforming obstacles into stepping stones for collective progress.
  • Product Management
    • Embrace the power of intention in product management; a solid will helps steer projects through uncertainty, keeping the vision aligned with strategic goals.
    • Transform insights and feedback into practical ideas; by rethinking and refining your perspective on market events, you can translate innovation into tangible success.
